pricing_project_pricing_determined.question: How is project pricing determined?
pricing_project_pricing_determined.answer: Because every business has different competition levels, target markets, and project goals, our pricing is customized to your exact requirements. We provide a transparent scope and quote after understanding your project.

pricing_there_minimum_contract.question: Is there a minimum contract?
pricing_there_minimum_contract.answer: No. Every engagement is month-to-month. We ask for a fair 3-month view because SEO compounds, but you can cancel any month with 15 days' notice.

pricing_why_avr_web.question: Why is AVR Web Consulting cost-effective?
pricing_why_avr_web.answer: We run a lean, senior team from Visakhapatnam, India, with no expensive sales layer. You pay directly for senior execution hours and strategy, not agency bloat.

pricing_competitive_pricing_mean.question: Does competitive pricing mean low quality?
pricing_competitive_pricing_mean.answer: No. Our competitive rates come from our efficient delivery model in India, not shortcuts. All work is manual and white-hat — no PBNs, no automated links, no scraped content.

pricing_ai_seo_addon.question: What does the AI SEO add-on include?
pricing_ai_seo_addon.answer: Answer-first content rewrites, entity and schema work, llms.txt and crawler access setup, plus monthly tracking of how often ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews cite your brand.

pricing_charge_setup_fee.question: Do you charge a setup fee?
pricing_charge_setup_fee.answer: No setup fee. The initial audit, keyword map and technical fix list are included in your first month.

pricing_bill_international_clients.question: How do you bill international clients?
pricing_bill_international_clients.answer: US, UK, UAE and EU clients are billed in USD via bank transfer, Wise or card. Indian clients are billed in INR with GST invoices.

pricing_i_buy_oneoff.question: Can I buy a one-off audit instead of an ongoing plan?
pricing_i_buy_oneoff.answer: Yes. A full technical, on-page and AI visibility audit is available as a standalone deliverable, and that fee is credited if you start an ongoing plan within 30 days.

pricing_results_should_i.question: What results should I expect from our services?
pricing_results_should_i.answer: Typically measurable technical and on-page gains in 30 days, first ranking movement in 60-90 days, and compounding traffic growth from month 4. Competitive national terms take longer.

pricing_prices_include_ad.question: Do prices include ad spend?
pricing_prices_include_ad.answer: No. Management fees are separate from ad budget, which you pay directly to Google or Meta so you keep full ownership of the ad accounts.
